game.title: Surung (Tunnel Game)
game.description: A traditional game where players form human tunnels by bending over in lines, while others crawl through. Tests agility and teamwork.
howToPlay: Step 1: Players divide into two teams.
Step 2: One team forms a tunnel by bending forward and placing hands on knees in a line.
Step 3: The other team takes turns crawling through the tunnel.
Step 4: After all players have crawled through, teams switch roles.
Step 5: The team that completes crawling faster wins.
Step 6: Variations include obstacles and timed challenges.
Step 7: Players must maintain tunnel formation throughout.
Step 8: Game builds teamwork and physical coordination.
Step 9: Popular during school sports days.
Step 10: Requires no equipment, making it accessible to all.
